Recurrence reads one token per step. Eac: A recurrent network reads one token per step. Each step waits for the one before it, so training cannot spread a sentence across a GPU.
The trade: all positions attend to each: The paper's trade: every position attends to every other position at once. Sequential steps O(n) → O(1), and compute per layer grows with n².
Self-attention is cheaper than recurrenc: Self-attention is cheaper than recurrence "when the sequence length n is smaller than the representation dimensionality d, which is most often the case" (§4). In 2017, n was a sentence of about 30 tokens and d was 512.
